stories.title: The Signal from Sector 7
stories.description: Deep space explorers discover an ancient, pulsating beacon on a desolate moon that seems to respond to human thought.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a human eye widening in terror, the pupil reflecting a pulsating alien monolith glowing with intense blue geometric light, cinematic motion blur, 8k, Wan 2.1
scenes.narration: They said Sector 7 was dead space. They were wrong. Something just woke up.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic wide shot, a sleek chrome spacecraft descending onto a jagged, obsidian-colored moon surface under a violet nebula sky, hyper-realistic, 8k, Wan 2.1
scenes.negative_prompt: bright sunlight, vegetation, low resolution, blurry, water
scenes.narration: In the silent vacuum of Sector 7, a rhythmic pulse began to echo through the hull of the Icarus.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close up of a glowing blue monolith half-buried in volcanic sand, intricate geometric patterns shifting on its surface, bioluminescent particles floating around it
scenes.narration: It wasn't a distress call. It was a countdown, etched in light and older than the stars themselves.

scenes.visual_prompt: An astronaut in a high-tech suit reaching out to touch the monolith, the reflection of the glowing patterns dancing on their visor, dramatic lighting
scenes.narration: As Commander Sarah reached out, the beacon didn't just glow—it whispered her name directly into her mind.
